## 2. Core Competencies & Tech Stack
1. **Search & Organic Growth**: Technical SEO, Programmatic SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO for LLMs), High-Authority Link Building, Multi-lingual International SEO, ASO (App Store Optimization).
2. **WCAG 2.2 / ADA & EAA Accessibility Compliance**: Automated DOM accessibility auditing and code-level remediation for Shopify, Next.js, React, and WordPress sites via proprietary scanner `a11ykit.site`.
3. **Paid Acquisition & Affiliate Management**: Google Ads (Search, PMax, Shopping, App Campaigns), Meta/Facebook Ads, Affiliate Network Management (ShareASale, Webgains, CJ), Media Buying & Anti-Fraud ROI Optimization.
4. **Data Analytics & Full-Funnel Monetization**: GA4 REST API & BigQuery Automation, Google Search Console (GSC) API, Subscription Funnel Optimization (2Checkout, Stripe, Google Play, Apple App Store), In-App Ad Mediation (Waterfall & Bidding).
5. **AI-Native Engineering (Vibe Coding)**: Rapid MVP & Engineering-as-Marketing Tool Development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Python Automation).

## 3. Live Proprietary Tool Matrix
